_metadata.description: Importing the source catalog without losing anything, and retiring it safely.

requirements.title: Import verifies counts per source file
requirements.description: The importer reports, per source file, how many records it read and how many it wrote, and fails loudly on a mismatch. The ordering rule is absolute: import, verify, then delete. Removing a source before its import is verified destroys the importer's only input.

validation.notes: Import a fixture copy of the source tree and assert per-file read/write parity.
Operator reviews the per-file count report before any source file is deleted.

requirements.title: Broken source references are reported, not silently dropped
requirements.description: The source catalog has a measured 19% broken internal-link rate. The importer records every unresolvable reference as a finding attached to the imported node rather than discarding it, so the drift is visible after the move instead of disappearing with it.

validation.notes: A fixture with a known-dangling reference produces exactly one finding and still imports the node.

requirements.title: Judgment prose is not imported
requirements.description: Only fields with a state or a lifecycle move: status, trigger, identifiers, and membership. Hypotheses, positioning, value propositions and portfolio-role narrative stay in the plan of record, because judgment frames belong in prose permanently.

validation.notes: The declared manifest marks narrative files none; the rehearsal report reads and writes only lifecycle, tier, and membership records.
